verdict.rationale: Pika is a hosted AI media-generation platform that handles user uploads and outputs, so a data-retention and deletion story applies to it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of retention settings, content or account deletion, or privacy controls. The pack covers creative features, pricing, sign-in, subscription cancellation and the API, none of which addresses data retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
